title: Chapter 777
paragraphs: Chapter 777
191. People who lead the era (1)
Honka has become a new member of the Vamel Alliance.
It was Valeria who asked him to join. Honka hesitated for a moment, but decided to leave the island and protect Valeria. He thought it was a continuation of his friend Marliet Hister's will.
"First a whale monster and now a toad monster! So cute. Welcome to the alliance, Mr. Honka. I'm the mage Enya."
[Pleased... to meet you.]
"Nice to meet you, Ghost Commander Lata Prochida."
"I'm the Black King Squad Leader, Valkas."
Each of the colleagues introduced themselves to Honka one by one.
Honka seemed slightly taken aback by the sudden voices of people. He also hadn't had any relationships with others, excluding Marliet, so it took effort to engage in normal conversation.
"Do you happen to know Mr. Mort!? He's also a toad."
"Yeah, since you're both toads, you could be friends."
[...He's a divine being, and I'm just a toad monster. How could we possibly be friends?]
"Mort isn't that intimidating of a toad."
Seeing Honka reminded Valeria of her past self. An awkward smile was drawn on her face due to embarrassment, and the colleagues found such Valeria interesting.
'I didn't know Valeria could make that kind of expression? I think I've seen it once or twice.'
'Doesn't she seem a bit more relaxed?'
'It feels like the atmosphere has become more mysterious with her. Hmm, I would feel a bit sorry for our lord, but if it's for Valeria...'
'Don't say such things lightly, Jet. It's okay since Sandra is not here now, but if she were, it would have caused a fuss.'
"I can hear everything."
"Ah."
"Hehe, you have good ears, Miss Valeria."
Booong-!
Right then, Mort appeared in the front yard of Tikan Castle with a loud cry that could be heard clearly. Syris, who was riding on Mort's back, also had an unusually flushed face.
"Welcome, Mr. Syris."
"Jin! Mother is finally regaining her consciousness. That's the news I just heard from the Holy Kingdom."
The eyes of Jin and his colleagues widened.
Queen Lani had started healing Talaris, and nearly half a year had already passed. During that time, Talaris was barely and intermittently regaining consciousness.
Normally, this level of recovery should have been more than enough, but the recent 'Eye of Zito' was showing ominous signs, so there was nothing to be done.
"Phew, really? Finally."
"If all goes well, she'll be able to get up by tonight or at the latest, by tomorrow. I thought I should let you know as soon as possible."
"Thank you for considering. It's been a heavy burden on my heart, as she fell into that state trying to save me. I'm relieved that she's waking up soon."
Talaris's return means that Misha can once again act as the deputy of Solderet. Therefore, Murakan, who had been acting as Misha's deputy all this while, could also return to his comrades.

In the current situation, Murakan's return would be a great strength more than anything else. If he were to return with most of his abilities from his prime, like when he appeared in the Shrine of Demons, the alliance of Runcandel and Vamel could potentially take the upper hand against all forces.
'Even if he hasn't fully regained his old strength, having Murakan would undoubtedly make us stronger.'
Above all, everyone missed Murakan. Especially Gilly, who sometimes cleaned up the room he used during break times.
[Booong? Boo, boong.]

Mort immediately recognized Honka and patted his shoulder with his front paw. It was a congratulatory gesture for deciding to leave the island. The two toads had already met three times in the past. Twice before Honka had his tribe, and once after becoming Marliet's toad.
[What? If I get along with people, you'll help me become a spirit?]
[Boong.]
[Why would you do me such a favor? Just because we're both toads doesn't mean we have to be friendly.]
And so, Honka quickly became friends with Mort. While the quick-witted Jet swiftly brought out a congratulatory drink to share with the group, Hedo and Sandra came out to the garden.
"My baby! Looks like you've managed to secure a communication device again!"
"You've worked hard, Jin. It's a relief that the Lady of the Endless Bow will soon wake up."

"But why is that redhead snickering in such an annoying way? It was already unpleasant and irritating to know that you and my baby went to the island together. Let's settle this today. Will you follow me to the training ground, or will we fight here? It wouldn't be bad to beat you in front of my baby."
As soon as Sandra recognized that Valeria's mood had changed, she started to rant.
There was a moment of tension among the colleagues. A good day, a good atmosphere could be ruined in an instant.
But unlike usual, Valeria calmly stared at Sandra, who was threateningly approaching her, and said.
"Pull yourself together, Sandra Zipple."
"Wow, fantastic. Really. What are you babbling about! Are you madly wanting to die!?"
"If you really want to fight me, I can oblige within limits that don't lead to death. But not today, so wait a bit."
At Valeria's response, the companions were so surprised that their mouths hung open. Up until now, Valeria had only dismissed Sandra as if looking at an insect, dust, or something less valuable.
The most surprised was Hedo.

Hedo thought that once Valeria had settled in Tikan, there was inevitably going to be some friction with her at some point. If the relationship between Sandra and Valeria ended in disaster, he would have to side with Sandra, while Jin would have to protect Valeria.
But for the first time, Valeria showed a somewhat friendly reaction. The person who always talked as if she was going to kill Sandra someday was now discussing a duel that would not risk their lives.
Sandra herself was somewhat flustered by Valeria's unexpected approach. Eventually, Sandra puffed herself up a bit more and then turned her head sharply.
"Such a fight would just ruin the fun. Hmm, I'll let it slide for today. But don't think you can fool my eyes. As long as you're eyeing our Jin, we can't share the same sky."
"Come on, let's not fight and have a drink."
Once the awkward conversation was over, Jet finished passing around the celebratory drinks.
Now it was time to check the rewards they had received from the Succession Ground. Qwaul brought the long-range communication device that Syris had fetched from the Gyeomwang area riding on Mort.
"Oh wow, this is a long-range communication device... it has a form quite similar to what Valeria and I are developing. Perhaps we weren't wrong after all."
Qwaul examined the communication device and the blueprints. He remained focused on the blueprints for quite a while.
"Hmm, oh. To think of this here? Zen Rootver was truly a great designer."
According to Qwaul, the communication device, like the Red Owl and the Wave Tracking Synchronization device, was based on 'waves'.

"Jin, the biggest challenge in developing a communication device was to accurately match the waves of each device in different spaces. Zen achieved this using wood as a catalyst. If you can insert the same wood into the device at any time, communication becomes possible."
The instructions obtained from the Succession Ground came with the bark of trees from Honka Island attached. When Qwaul inserted one into the home of the communication device, a blue light sprang up.

At the same time, a hidden button also popped up. The button indicated the other communication devices that could currently be connected. As only two devices with wood bark were currently connected, it was the communication device on Honka Island.

When Qwaul pressed the button firmly, the wood bark began to char slightly in the blue light, and a pleasant resonance sound rang out. It was the sound created when a communication request was made to Honka Island.
{[Honka, Island. Successors, you're testing the communication device.]}
{[Oh, they've already got in touch!?]}
{[Is it working well, guys!]}

Voices of Golem, Zen, and Teben simultaneously came from the communication device. Companions were momentarily lost for words at the astonishing performance of the new device, and their eyes blinked in amazement.
It was a moment to realize that the world is developing at a crazy fast pace. Ships became common, spatial leap ships emerged, and now the era of ultra-long-distance communication has arrived.
"Yes, thanks to you."
For a while, greetings were exchanged between the crew and Honka Island. The tree bark burned very slowly, so a single piece was enough for long communication.

"Hey, Zen Ruthver and Teben Hister, you guys are geniuses worthy of my approval. Thanks to you, I've made great strides in my research! I never thought to track wavelengths using catalysts in this way."
{[Hohoho, seems like you're at a level to understand our blueprints based on your talk about wavelengths.]}

"Hahaha, I found possible improvements as soon as I saw the blueprints. Just changing the type of iron can lower the manufacturing cost and increase stability. However, I had difficulty understanding the golem's blueprint. You guys will have to help with this part."
If even Qwaul said so, it could be assumed that there was no human who could understand the golem's blueprint in the current world.
{[We didn't make the golem, so that's impossible.]}
"What? Then how am I supposed to make this? It seems like it would take at least several decades to study it alone."
{[My brother, I will, help with, the manufacturing. My master, left, all related, knowledge, recorded in, me. For a day, like this. With the Champions' approval, it will, do.]}
Eiello asked Qwaul several questions to gauge his level for a while, then told him that he could make a golem within three years with his help.
"Three years, huh? You're underestimating me. I'll complete your brother in a year."
[I will, look forward to, it. But, Champions. Have you, used, the storage paper?]
"Storage paper? What's that?"
"Jin Confucius, did you acquire anything else apart from the communication device and the blueprint for the ultra-high-performance golem?"
Jin gave a sly smile and answered Eiello like this.
"We tested one piece of paper on the way here. From now on, it will be used to create the Magic Knights of the Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance."
